integrity.computation: Matrix determinant, graph-neighborhood exhaustive checks through n=16, polynomial recurrence through n=39
integrity.proof_scope: All n≥5 by a local obstruction lemma and an exact 16-state trace identity
integrity.unproved: No extension to arbitrary graphs or equivalence classes under automorphism; no independently verified priority

scientific_limitations: Labelled simple cycles of order at least five; one distinguished locating-dominating role and a complementary dominating role. Does not count unmarked, unlabeled or double-locating partitions. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact role-marked domination–location polynomial of cycles
